parsed.note_claim: The tape in the video is aerospace-grade speed tape used for minor, temporary aircraft repairs, not ordinary tape.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Speed tape is an aluminum pressure-sensitive tape primarily used for temporary, non-critical repairs on aircraft. While some passengers might mistake speed tape for regular duct tape, it has become an essential and recognized tool in commercial aviation maintenance.
parsed.reason: The page directly describes speed tape as an aluminum tape for temporary non-critical aircraft repairs, distinct from duct tape, and recognized in commercial aviation.
